title: Customer Terms: Ending a Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program
content:
**1.** Only the customer can end an active Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program. Larkfield records the cancellation as a program cancellation request, and the program closes only when the customer personally confirms that request.

**2.** A confirmed cancellation closes the program with the closure reason customer discontinued, or changed supplier when the customer states they are moving these supplies to another supplier. A cancellation of a program on hold is closed under the program hold and closure rules.

**3.** Ending a program carries no fee and cancels nothing the customer already owes: the balance stays payable, credit balances are still refunded under the patient balance rules, and unopened items delivered within the return window stay returnable under the returns policy.

**4.** Authorized units remaining on a closed program lapse and are never shipped; a later restart needs a new referral and a new program.

**5.** A package already shipped is not recalled.

| Customer's position | Closure reason recorded on confirmation |
|---|---|
| ends the program and names no other supplier | customer discontinued |
| states the supplies are moving to another supplier | changed supplier |

A request that the customer has not personally confirmed leaves the program open.
